'''Khin Myint Myint''' ({{langx|my|ခင်မြင့်မြင့်}}; 1944–19 September 2009) was a Burmese [[beauty pageant]] titleholder, businesswoman and philanthropist. She was president of the Myanmar Women Entrepreneurs Association. She was crowned [[Miss Burma (1947–1962)|Miss Burma 1961]] and represented her country at [[Miss Universe 1961]].

==Early life==
Khin Myint Myint was born in the [[Daik-U Township]], [[Bago Region|Bago Division]] in 1944, and attended [[BEHS 2 Dagon|Myoma High School]], where she distinguished herself in [[throwing sports]].<ref name="MT" />

==Career==
At age 17, Khin Myint Myint won the [[Miss Burma (1947–1962)|Miss Burma beauty pageant]] in 1961 and represented her country at the [[Miss Universe 1961|Miss Universe]] event held at [[Miami Beach, Florida]]. Later she became a businessperson and established a name for herself in the food industry. Also known for her philanthropy, she reportedly donated more than [[Myanmar kyat|Ks.]]300 million for humanitarian causes which earned her the ''[[Thiri Thudhamma Thingaha|Agga Maha Thiri Thudhamma Theingi]]'' title.<ref name="MT">{{cite news|author=Nyein Ei Ei Htwe|title=Former 'Miss Burma' winner passes away|url=https://www.mmtimes.com/national-news/6057-former-miss-burma-winner-passes-away.html|access-date=11 November 2017|work=[[The Myanmar Times]]|date=28 September 2009|archive-date=12 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171112021143/https://www.mmtimes.com/national-news/6057-former-miss-burma-winner-passes-away.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2008, Khin Myint Myint received the ASEAN Award of the [[Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry]]. She was the president of Myanmar Women Entrepreneurs Association and vice-chairperson of AA Medical Products.<ref name="ICC">{{cite web|title=Vietnam chamber hosts Women's Global Summit|url=https://iccwbo.org/media-wall/news-speeches/vietnam-chamber-hosts-womens-global-summit/|publisher=[[International Chamber of Commerce]]|access-date=11 November 2017|date=19 June 2008}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Khin Myint Myint was married to Myat Thin Aung. Together the couple had six children. She died on 19 September 2009 from a [[heart attack]]; she was 65.<ref name="MT"/>
